summary: 1. **Symlinked settings entries show no diff (low–moderate)** — `settingsChanges` diffs the listed path ( ), but for an unchanged symlink whose target changed, that path is byte-identical between revisions, so the user sees `(no textual diff)` and approves with no evidence. Reproduced in a scratch repo. Fix: diff the resolved target blobs (`git diff base:<oldAt> head:<newAt>`).
body: 2. **One edit can be listed twice under two ids (low)** — when a file is reachable under two scannable names (e.g. `b.ts` symlinked as `a.ts`), one edit produces two approval gates (`switch-offs.ts:828-831`). Safe direction (over-asks, never under-asks), but possibly unintentional — the spec doesn't say the target should also be listed.
